decision_scope: For repository github.com/zycaskevin/agentic-sdd-governance and trust domain agentic-sdd-governance-owner-2026q3, retire and reject SDDGOV_TRUSTED_APPROVERS_FILE; make logical /etc/sddgov/trusted-approvers.json the sole Linux/macOS runtime approver key store; require the Base-compatible signed receipt plus the fixed root-controlled /etc/sddgov/trusted-approver-domains.json sidecar binding the Owner key to that repository, one exact separately provisioned host-local repository root, and that trust domain; and add the separated non-signing Agent card plus Owner-terminal confirmed-signer flow, under the exact ownership, path-chain, migration, custody, fail-closed, and non-provisioning boundaries in work-packages/DEC-RC1-APPROVER-AUTHORITY-R22.md.

decision_package.why_human_input_is_required: The trusted Base permits an environment-selected external root-owned approver store; fixing and rejecting that selector changes the public authority-source contract and cannot be authorized by the candidate itself.
what_agent_already_verified: The trusted Base authority contract and current implementation were compared at exact Base 1a5a0b214eccc2b9edd076fd5e2f222c4a456725.
The fixed-path prototype rejects the legacy environment selector, fails closed for root Agents, bounds the JSON document, and retains and rechecks the complete root-owned non-writable path chain.
The Agent CLI can only render the validated card; the separate Owner CLI reconstructs and verifies a receipt without accepting private-key or signature material.
Actual /etc writes, real Owner key provisioning, service installation, and Production operations remain separate Operational/L3 actions.

options.label: A
options.description: Approve the exact fixed-path authority contract, custody assumptions, and separated Owner approval client bound by work-packages/DEC-RC1-APPROVER-AUTHORITY-R22.md.

options.label: B
options.description: Retain the trusted Base behavior in which SDDGOV_TRUSTED_APPROVERS_FILE selects an external root-owned store.

decision_package.why: It removes caller-selected authority routing, reduces the Owner action to one semantic choice through a separately held signer, preserves fail-closed separation, and does not grant the distinct privilege to provision or operate the control plane.
decision_package.impact_if_no_decision: Only the R22 merge remains blocked; tests, Evidence preparation, rollback proof, and independent review can continue.
